crossRefs.note: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Nile
people.line: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts

translations.web: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.
translations.bsb: So all the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water to drink, because they could not drink the water from the river.
translations.kjv: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
translations.asv: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
